maintenance_led.reason: Builds, resurfaces and maintains roads, highways and runways; the split between new construction and maintenance isn't stated.

publicly_funded.reason: Most work is paving highways, roads and airport runways for state, federal and municipal agencies; private developers are the smaller part.

mission_critical.reason: Road and paving work is won by competitive public bids, so agencies can change contractors easily between projects.

notes: The website doesn't say how much revenue comes from maintenance and resurfacing versus new construction.
